title: What is the Higgsfield API, and how do I get started?
snippet:
A subscription on [higgsfield.ai](http://higgsfield.ai) and the API are two separate products with separate billing. Your plan, credits, and Unlimited access exist only on the website; the API runs on its own account balance in US dollars.
How is the API different from my Higgsfield plan?
| Criteria | Higgsfield plan ([higgsfield.ai](https://higgsfield.ai/)) | Higgsfield API |
|---|---|---|
| Who it's for | Creators working in the visual interface | Developers building generation into their own products |
| Billing | Subscription plus credits | US dollar balance, pay per generation |
| Unlimited models | Yes, where included in plan | Not applicable |
| Requires the other | No | No |

Through MCP, the same generations deduct plan credits at standard rates, and $1 corresponds to 20 credits. Plans start at Starter for $15/mo, with Plus at $49/mo ($39 annual) and Ultra at $129/mo ($99 annual).

snippet:

Yes. The Higgsfield AI Creator Partnership Program is our take on a creative partner program. We say Creator because Higgsfield is a full creative suite, and the program is for everyone building with it.
CPP is our partnership program with a plan, credits, early access, and community. The Earn program at [higgsfield.ai](https://higgsfield.ai/) runs paid campaigns open to creators of any size, a good place to start if you want to work with us before applying to CPP. The two also work together: as a CPP partner, you can receive your own individual Earn campaigns on top of everything the program already gives you.

title: Meet the Higgsfield API: How It Works and What You Get
snippet:
The Higgsfield API is a self-serve API for developers that provides direct access to more than 50 current video and image generation models with pay-as-you-go billing in US dollars. There is no subscription: you top up a balance, pay per generation at published rates, and spending stops automatically at zero.

The API is a separate product from the [higgsfield.ai](http://higgsfield.ai) website. A plan on [higgsfield.ai](http://higgsfield.ai) does not affect API access, and API usage is billed independently.

Setting up access takes four steps:
1. Create an account and choose between personal and company use.
2. Add a payment method and top up your balance.
3. Create your first API key. The key is shown once at creation, so store it securely. Creating a key unlocks 20 concurrent requests.
4. Integrate using the Python or TypeScript SDK, or call the REST API directly from any language with an HTTP client. Each model page includes ready code samples, plus prepared setup prompts for Claude Code, Cursor, and ChatGPT (Codex) that configure the integration from a single instruction.

- **Billing is per request.** You add a payment method, top up a balance, and each generation deducts its cost from the balance. Access does not require a plan or a seat fee.

title: Higgsfield AI Creator Partnership Program: What It Is, What You Get, and How to Join
snippet:
Higgsfield works closely with a growing group of creators who build content with AI video, image, and creative tools, and the [Creator Partnership Program](https://higgsfield.ai/creator-partnership-program) is the structure that has developed around those relationships. Partners get monthly credits that reset every cycle, early access to new models before they go public, direct contact with the creator team, and a private community of people doing the same work across every platform. The program is free for accepted partners, and every application gets an individual response.

What Partners Get
| Benefit | What It Means in Practice |
|---|---|
| Free plan + credits | A full plan renewed every month, plus additional credits for larger projects, films, and series |
| Growth support | Tips, playbooks, and hands-on advice from the Higgsfield team on audience growth and content quality |
| Direct line to the team | Direct contact with the creator team for credits, questions, technical issues, or feedback |
| Early access | New models and features reach partners before public release |
| Exclusive community | A private community of partners across every platform for sharing what works and collaborating |
| Getting featured | Partnership work appears across Higgsfield channels and the creator hub |
## Credits That Actually Let You Work
Partners get a full plan renewed monthly, which means the generation capacity resets rather than accumulating into a debt of unused work that disappears at the end of the billing cycle. For larger projects, whether that is a short film, a series, or a campaign that genuinely needs more than a standard monthly allocation, additional credits are available through the program. The practical effect is that consistent, high-volume output becomes possible without the familiar anxiety of watching a credit counter tick toward zero at the exact wrong moment in a project.

The terms are straightforward: tag or mention Higgsfield when the tools are part of your work, and engage with launches when they are relevant to what you are already making. That is the whole agreement. Beyond that, you have full creative freedom. You keep full ownership of your work and your voice.
In return, you get monthly credits that reset every cycle, early access to new models before they go public, direct contact with the creator team, and a private community of people doing the same work across every platform and every market.
